title: Compatible reduced units through a coherent proper supporting quotient
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a separated finite type morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ with projections $j_n:X_n\to X$ and $b_n:X_n\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ satisfy $j_{n+1}\circ i_n=j_n$ and $b_{n+1}\circ i_n=t_n\circ b_n$, where $t_n$ is induced by the quotient map $A/I^{n+2}\to A/I^{n+1}$. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the pinned tensor-pullback composition comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ forming cartesian squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be coherent [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and let $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ satisfy $\beta_n i_n^*(\psi_{n+1})=\psi_nc_n$, where $\beta_n$ is affine base change followed by the structure-sheaf pullback map [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Then there exist a coherent module $Q$ on $X$ with support proper over $A$, a module morphism $q:\mathcal O_X\to Q$, and morphisms $v_n:j_n^*Q\to j_n^*G$ with $v_nc_{n,Q}=c_{n,G}i_n^*(v_{n+1})$, such that, for every open $U$ and scalar section $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, the adjoint of $\psi_nv_n$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-structure-adjoint-transitions] sends $q_U(r)$ to $(j_np_n)^\sharp_U(r)$. No completeness of A and no multiplication or lifted unit on G is assumed.

proof.text: X is locally Noetherian as locally finite type over Spec A. Apply the coherence criterion to G and take the scheme-theoretic supporting closed immersion k:Z -> X from the annihilator/support conjunct of module_support_proper_over_base. Its properness follows from hproper. Construct Q=k_*O_Z and q=the structure module map. Finite pushforward gives coherence and finite_structure_proper_support gives proper support.

The closed-immersion unit is epi by closedImmersion_unit_quotient. Compare its chosen adjunction with the pinned adjunction, and compose with pushforward of the canonical structure-unit isomorphism; its unit characterization proves that q is epi. The new supported-unit kernel theorem says that j_n^*kernel(q) is killed by the canonical structure unit into p_n,*O_Yn. Since tensor pullback is an additive left adjoint, it preserves the cokernel presentation of q. Descend the structure unit through j_n^*q by the mapped cokernel universal property, then compose with psi_n inverse to construct v_n.

Prove the canonical structure-unit composition identity from unit_conjugateEquiv_symm and the pinned mate definition. After applying the composite adjunction Hom equivalence and pushforward comparison, both sides are the scheme composite structure map. For compatibility, cancel psi_n and precompose with the epi i_n^*j_(n+1)^*q. Naturality of c_n and the two quotient descent equations reduce the comparison to preservation of units by moduleBaseChangeMap_algebra. That unit identity and hpsi_n identify the two sides. hp and hw are not needed for this calculation.

Naturality of the adjunction unit identifies q followed by the adjoint of v_n psi_n with the adjoint of the canonical reduced structure unit. The structure-unit characterization and pushforward composition identify this adjoint with the structure map for p_n followed by j_n. Evaluate the module equality on U and r. Assemble Q, q, v and the two proved equations into the required existential statement.

theorem finite_structure_unit_quotient_system
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (hi n)).symm)
    (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
    (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    [∀ n, IsFinite (fnY n)]
    (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1))
    (hcart : ∀ n, IsPullback (fnY n) (gn n) (i n) (fnY (n + 1)))
    (hw : ∀ n, gn n ≫ (fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) =
      fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G)
    (ψ : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf))
    (hψ : ∀ n,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (fnY (n + 1)) (fnY n) (i n) (gn n)
          (hcart n).flip.w (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (gn n))) =
        (c n).hom.app G ≫ (ψ n).hom) :
    ∃ Q : X.Modules, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace Q ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f Q ∧
      ∃ (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ Q)
        (v : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj Q ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G),
        (∀ n : ℕ, (c n).hom.app Q ≫ v n =
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (v (n + 1)) ≫ (c n).hom.app G) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)),
          (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
            (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) Q (v n ≫ (ψ n).hom)).app U
            ((q.val.app (op U)).hom r) =
            (fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).app U r)
